question:
Select the Venn diagram that best represents the relationship between the following classes.

Living things, Animals, Birds, Dogs
solution:
The Venn diagram that best represents the relationship between Living things, Animals, Birds, and Dogs is shown below:

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f2b04d2bf0121854ea6eae3d9157962debc6e24ae1c0d7685acf0599e1cac7ea.png] 

**All living organisms can be classified into two major groups- plants and animals.**

All Birds and Dogs are animals. All animals are living things.

Hence, '**option 2**' is the correct answer.
